sample_unit: whole slide images (from 95 patients), read by 3 pathologists with and without AI
models_evaluated: AI lymph node metastasis detection module (whole slide image)

links.outcome: Pathologist sensitivity, specificity, and review time with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: AI assistance increased sensitivity from 91.8%-93.9% to 95.9% for all pathologists; specificity remained 97.0%-98.9%; review time decreased by up to 78% for some cancer types.
links.quote: AI assistance increased sensitivity-which ranged from 91.8% to 93.9%-to 95.9% for all pathologists, while specificity remained high (97.0%-98.9%).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the impact of an AI diagnostic assistance tool on pathologist workflow and diagnostic accuracy using a reader study design (with vs. without AI assistance).
